prerequisitesDetail: Copy/save/paste/loadApply require current projectIdentity/revision/existing Mixer index and no gesture/take/native control/capture/projection work. Paste requires portable clipboard; loadApply decodes a direct .vibfx child of the configured existing local preset directory. Apply fresh-captures outgoing target state, privately prepares one canonical replacement, permits a brief existing audio reconfiguration, and completes only after publication and actual source activation (or explicit initial deferredNoDevice document completion). Pure structural Mixer-effects Undo/Redo uses the same interrupted path; no mixed-route/music fallback. Cancel drains actual owned capture/file/worker preparation before publication; after publication tooLate retains intended model and explicit native recovery state. Copy/save/loadClipboard remain nonmutating. Configure preserves root/history on refusal. Native provenance covers acknowledged supported interfaces; unsignalled widget edits remain outside guarantees.

nativeRecoveryRequired.description: True when irreversible publication requires explicit native recovery; never interpret as successful active playback.

recoveryOperation.description: Exact separately owned device-preparation operation, if automatic recovery was admitted. A chain timeout does not cancel or silently destroy this persistent owner; inspect vibera_mixer action=devicePreparation with this operation.

audioState.description: Apply audio projection state. Queued preparation/model acceptance is not actual active playback; deferredNoDevice has no active device. Published activation has a10000ms QPC bound; timeout fails retaining intended model/history with nativeRecoveryRequired.

operation.description: Current-session Channel clone/delete job ID, required for job/cancel. Poll until terminal. Completion means the actual document transaction committed after state capture; read audio state for subsequent engine preparation/plugin health.

muteRemovedSteps.description: configure only: persist the Workflow preference. False deletes removed step chords; true retains their source IDs/properties as muted notes. Reactivation restores them. Initially false for legacy compatibility; not musical Undo. Do not combine with another persistent preference or graph changes. Activation edits the raw source position, independently of playback-loop repetition or shrinkage.

restoreMuteAfterSolo.description: For configure: persist the Workflow solo-restore preference before changing live settings. Initially true. Preferences are not musical Undo.

graphProperty.description: For configure: select the graph property through the shared view service. Session view state, not musical Undo. Do not combine with restoreMuteAfterSolo or muteRemovedSteps. Pitch has MIDI0-127 units/reset60; local sampler Pan normalized-1..1 and Fine Pitch cents-100..100 reset0. Shift percent0-100 resets0 and delays percent*0.002475 quarter-note beats; supported on all score instruments. Repeat selects rhythmic rate0-14 (Off through64th triplet), all score instruments; source duration gates repeats and source IDs remain stable. Release normalized0..1/default0 is MIDI note-off data, not ADSR duration; local sampler and current native Synth ignore it, other instruments are patch-dependent. Native/VST3 pan/fine unsupported. Mod X/Y0..1 neutral0.5 offset local sampler filter cutoff/resonance using original clamp(global+2*(note-0.5),0,1); Filter Off is a no-op. Native/VST3 Mod X/Y unsupported; source metadata is not a voice/DSP ACK. Edit canonical steps.pitch/pan/fine/shift/repeat/release/modX/modY via stepGraph lease.

graphVisible.description: For configure: show/hide the selected-Channel step Graph Editor. Initially false; session view state, not musical Undo. Ctrl+K/UI share this service. Edit existing in-window on-grid source steps (including muted/zero-velocity notes, retaining activation) through steps.velocity and vibera_gesture domain=stepVelocity. Pitch/Pan/Fine/Shift/Repeat/Release/Mod X/Mod Y use graphProperty and canonical steps.pitch/pan/fine/shift/repeat/release/modX/modY, with stepGraph history. Pan/Fine and Mod X/Y require local sampler targets. Other properties remain unsupported.

firstRow.description: For scroll: zero-based visible Channel row, clamped to viewport bounds. Omit to retain.

firstStep.description: For scroll: zero-based step column, clamped to the full explicit Pattern length. Omit to retain.

kind.description: Required for filter. All/Unsorted are virtual views, not group IDs.

group.description: Stable group ID, required only for kind=group.

ids.description: Stable Channel IDs, required for select. Group/clone/delete default to shared Rack selection; explicit clone/delete needs 1..128 IDs. Clone inserts settings-only copies adjacent to each source and selects them; delete removes their notes in every Pattern and owned Audio Clips, never files.

activeChannel.description: Optional explicit active instrument/MIDI recipient. Selection alone preserves the active recipient and held take.

allChannels.description: For all: true selects the whole project; false selects visible rows.

name.description: For group: existing or new name, 1..128 characters, no outer spaces, All/Unsorted reserved. One Undo includes creation and assignment.

prerequisitesDetail: No recording take/gesture/macro/file operation. Shared asynchronous state capture; poll vibera_rack job/cancel. Completion is model commit, not plugin activation. Clone excludes score/events/external automation; delete removes notes in every Pattern and owned audio placements. Undo restores captured instrument state. Not supported by synchronous document macros.

muteRemovedSteps.description: configure only: persist the Workflow preference. False deletes removed step chords; true retains their source IDs/properties as muted notes. Reactivation restores them. graphProperty.description: For configure: select the graph property through the shared view service. Session view state, not musical Undo. Do not combine with restoreMuteAfterSolo or muteRemovedSteps. Pitch has MIDI0-127 units/reset60; local sampler Pan normalized-1..1 and Fine Pitch cents-100..100 reset0. Shift percent0-100 resets0 and delays percent*0.002475 quarter-note beats; supported on all score instruments. Repeat selects rhythmic rate0-14 (Off through64th triplet), all score instruments; source duration gates repeats and source IDs remain stable. Release normalized0..1/default0 is MIDI note-off data, not ADSR duration; local sampler and current native Synth ignore it, other instruments are patch-dependent. Native/VST3 pan/fine unsupported. Mod X/Y0..1 neutral0.5 offset local sampler filter cutoff/resonance using original clamp(global+2*(note-0.5),0,1); Filter Off is a no-op. Native/VST3 Mod X/Y unsupported; source metadata is not a voice/DSP ACK. Edit canonical steps.pitch/pan/fine/shift/repeat/release/modX/modY via stepGraph lease.

referenceStart.description: Actual selected callback reference sample start, not beat time.

nativeRecoveryRequired.description: True when irreversible publication requires explicit native recovery; never interpret as successful active playback.

recoveryOperation.description: Exact separately owned device-preparation operation, if automatic recovery was admitted. A chain timeout does not cancel or silently destroy this persistent owner; inspect vibera_mixer action=devicePreparation with this operation.

audioState.description: Apply audio projection state. Queued preparation/model acceptance is not actual active playback; deferredNoDevice has no active device. Published activation has a10000ms QPC bound; timeout fails retaining intended model/history with nativeRecoveryRequired.

stateReadback: Numeric operation: existing vibera_mixer routingJob/cancelRouting. String operation: existing vibera_mixerchain job/cancel, exact token. Delayed/auxiliary or general FX structural operations use one full native capture and bounded interrupted Apply; no fallback after native guard refusal. Existing send-level updates retain live controls. Pending/cancelled/committed activation failure are distinct; inspect the returned actual job.

resultPolling.retention: Latest32 terminal operations; unknown/expired IDs return routing.unknownOperation.

cancellation.description: The synchronous preparation/publication has finished before command admission returns. A returned job cannot be rolled back by cancelling. Too-late is failure of the cancellation request, not completion/failure of the underlying route: keep polling the original job; use checked Undo only after its terminal state.

prerequisitesDetail: Existing current-session Channel and Mixer index; selectedChannel is only a default target. Read current project identity/revision and supply optional top-level projectIdentity/revision guards to refuse a replaced session or stale revision. No active local/remote gesture, recording/retained take, project/import/export/state/recovery or competing plugin mutation; shared Studio/Controller admission may refuse or finish only its supported checked work. Does not replace instruments or alter score. One changed assignment is one canonical Undo/Redo; assigning the existing insert is an exact no-op. Assignment-only batches/macros use the coordinator; mixed route/content sequences refuse atomically.
completionGuidance: Accepted/pending is not completed: require the exact operation's terminal receipt. For liveGraph, nativeCompletionKnown and posted/selectedSerial plus actual referenceStart/End describe software callback adoption; neither proves listening or hardware. deferredNoDevice with completionScope=document commits model/history only, retaining audioProjectionDeferred; it does not start a device, render offline audio or prove audible routing. noChange is a no-op. Inspect documentCommitted/documentChanged and structured error after failure because a later context/device interruption can follow a committed document. Never blindly retry a pending or committed job; poll/read current state first.
prerequisites: Current project and existing stable Channel/Mixer IDs; no conflicting owner/work. Shared checked command/history and prepared audio admission apply. Inspect operation scope and poll real native selection; document-only deferred completion is explicit.

prerequisitesDetail: Complete typed project-owned link with fixed Channel and sampler parameter. Create requires a local sampler. Existing unsupported-role links remain dormant and reserve their source. Conflicts require explicit exact project replacement IDs; global preferences are retained. Shared validation and one document Undo; no-op does not create history. Configuration completion is canonical document publication, not a DSP or disk acknowledgement. Use pending samplerLearnStart/State/Accept/Cancel for hardware identification; ordinary project Save persists it. Typed mapping payloads are unavailable in the current scalar document-macro format.

operation.description: Current-session Channel clone/delete job ID, required for job/cancel. Poll until terminal. Completion means the actual document transaction committed after state capture; read audio state for subsequent engine preparation/plugin health.

muteRemovedSteps.description: configure only: persist the Workflow preference. False deletes removed step chords; true retains their source IDs/properties as muted notes. Reactivation restores them. Initially false for legacy compatibility; not musical Undo. Do not combine with another persistent preference or graph changes. Activation edits the raw source position, independently of playback-loop repetition or shrinkage.

restoreMuteAfterSolo.description: For configure: persist the Workflow solo-restore preference before changing live settings. Initially true. Preferences are not musical Undo.

graphProperty.description: For configure: select the graph property through the shared view service. Session view state, not musical Undo. Do not combine with restoreMuteAfterSolo or muteRemovedSteps. Pitch has MIDI0-127 units/reset60; local sampler Pan normalized-1..1 and Fine Pitch cents-100..100 reset0. Shift percent0-100 resets0 and delays percent*0.002475 quarter-note beats; supported on all score instruments. Repeat selects rhythmic rate0-14 (Off through64th triplet), all score instruments; source duration gates repeats and source IDs remain stable. Release normalized0..1/default0 is MIDI note-off data, not ADSR duration; local sampler and current native Synth ignore it, other instruments are patch-dependent. Native/VST3 pan/fine unsupported. Mod X/Y0..1 neutral0.5 offset local sampler filter cutoff/resonance using original clamp(global+2*(note-0.5),0,1); Filter Off is a no-op. Native/VST3 Mod X/Y unsupported; source metadata is not a voice/DSP ACK. Edit canonical steps.pitch/pan/fine/shift/repeat/release/modX/modY via stepGraph lease.

graphVisible.description: For configure: show/hide the selected-Channel step Graph Editor. Initially false; session view state, not musical Undo. Ctrl+K/UI share this service. Edit existing in-window on-grid source steps (including muted/zero-velocity notes, retaining activation) through steps.velocity and vibera_gesture domain=stepVelocity. Pitch/Pan/Fine/Shift/Repeat/Release/Mod X/Mod Y use graphProperty and canonical steps.pitch/pan/fine/shift/repeat/release/modX/modY, with stepGraph history. Pan/Fine and Mod X/Y require local sampler targets. Other properties remain unsupported.

firstRow.description: For scroll: zero-based visible Channel row, clamped to viewport bounds. Omit to retain.

firstStep.description: For scroll: zero-based step column, clamped to the full explicit Pattern length. Omit to retain.

kind.description: Required for filter. All/Unsorted are virtual views, not group IDs.

group.description: Stable group ID, required only for kind=group.

ids.description: Stable Channel IDs, required for select. Group/clone/delete default to shared Rack selection; explicit clone/delete needs 1..128 IDs. Clone inserts settings-only copies adjacent to each source and selects them; delete removes their notes in every Pattern and owned Audio Clips, never files.

graphProperty.description: For configure: select the graph property through the shared view service. Session view state, not musical Undo. Do not combine with restoreMuteAfterSolo or muteRemovedSteps. Pitch has MIDI0-127 units/reset60; local sampler Pan normalized-1..1 and Fine Pitch cents-100..100 reset0. Shift percent0-100 resets0 and delays percent*0.002475 quarter-note beats; supported on all score instruments. Repeat selects rhythmic rate0-14 (Off through64th triplet), all score instruments; source duration gates repeats and source IDs remain stable. Release normalized0..1/default0 is MIDI note-off data, not ADSR duration; local sampler and current native Synth ignore it, other instruments are patch-dependent. Native/VST3 pan/fine unsupported. Mod X/Y0..1 neutral0.5 offset local sampler filter cutoff/resonance using original clamp(global+2*(note-0.5),0,1); Filter Off is a no-op. Native/VST3 Mod X/Y unsupported; source metadata is not a voice/DSP ACK. Edit canonical steps.pitch/pan/fine/shift/repeat/release/modX/modY via stepGraph lease.

name: Apply Advanced Fill recipes
qualification: Consult coverage inventory and exact workflow receipts; registration is not verification.

pattern.description: Explicit stable Pattern ID. Atomic multi-Channel source-cycle replacement and loop settings; one Undo. Source beyond cycle survives; ordinary playback uses incremental scheduling. Document completion is not DSP adoption.

channel.description: Existing stable instrument Channel ID, never a row index; Audio Clips excluded.

sequenceSteps.description: Source cycle in sixteenth-note cells; one cell=0.25 quarter-note beats. Replaces only source notes before cycle end.

mode.description: Original mask algorithm. Every starts at zero; Euclidean hits floor(k*steps/pulses).

every.description: Every-N spacing, must not exceed sequenceSteps in every mode.

pulses.description: Euclidean hit count, must not exceed sequenceSteps in euclidean mode.

rotation.description: Signed cell shift; positive moves later, modulo cycle.

dice.description: Redistribute generated hit count deterministically, before rotation.

loop.description: True sets this Pattern part's fixed cycle; false removes its loop and may reveal retained source notes beyond the replacement window.

convertMelodic.description: Explicit consent to floor in-cycle melodic/off-grid notes to step cells and set length0.25. Otherwise refuse atomically.

manual.description: Manual mode needs exactly sequenceSteps binary values.

retainSteps.description: Omit to follow Workflow muteRemovedSteps. True keeps off-mask notes muted and reactivates on-mask notes, preserving existing step properties/chord IDs. False uses legacy replacement deletion/mute behavior. Explicit melodic conversion still required; opening/unchanged interactive Accept applies no recipes and is a no-op.

stateReadback: vibera_stepCompose action=state; vibera_inspect notes and Pattern channelLoops; vibera_state pendingAudioUpdate separately

Exact operation token required for subsequent semantic session actions. Macro recipe Channels stay explicit; no native vendor widgets or DSP adoption acknowledged.
